"""Camera-guided GR1 pepper transfer, using only public robot observations."""
import json, sys, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=Path('/app/output')
R=np.array([[0.,-1.,0.],[1.,0.,0.],[0.,0.,1.]])
t=np.array([2.66261,-2.15254,0.88087])
def wb(p): return R.T@(np.asarray(p)-t)
def bw(p): return R@np.asarray(p)+t
def state(obs):
 q=dict(zip(obs.meta['proprio']['layout'],obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
 return np.array([q['cmd_'+x] for x in ['right_x','right_y','right_z','right_rx','right_ry','right_rz','left_x','left_y','left_z','left_rx','left_ry','left_rz','right_little','right_ring','right_middle','right_index','right_thumb_flexion','right_thumb_rotation','left_little','left_ring','left_middle','left_index','left_thumb_flexion','left_thumb_rotation']],dtype=float)
def submit(r,target,steps=30,tag='move',cams=('egoview','robot0_eye_in_right_hand'),depth=True):
 obs=r.get_obs(cameras=list(cams),video='none')
 start=state(obs)
 actions=np.linspace(start,np.array(target,float),steps)
 res=r.submit('ee_pose',actions,cameras=list(cams),include_depth=depth,video='none',note=tag)
 res.save(str(ROOT/tag))
 print(tag, 'steps',res.meta['control_steps'],'time left',res.meta['time_left_s'],'eef',[(k,v) for k,v in zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']) if k.startswith('eef_')])
 return res
if __name__=='__main__':
 r=Robot(); obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['egoview','robot0_eye_in_right_hand'],video='none')
 a=state(obs);a[12:18]=[1,1,1,1,1,0.5]
 submit(r,a,30,'hand_close_test')
PY
